metric_description: Gross global Scope 1 emissions, percentage covered under emissionslimiting regulations
sasb_what_counts: Two values: (1) total gross global Scope 1 GHG emissions in metric tonnes CO2-e from all owned/operated refining and marketing assets (combustion, process emissions, fugitives); (2) percentage covered under emissions-limiting regulations (cap-and-trade, carbon tax, regulatory limits). Note: unlike EM-EP, does NOT require methane percentage breakdown.
